title: 3 Bombs vs. Stockfish
summary: Tony replaces his queen with an explosive piece (three levels, one per game) vs Fairy-Stockfish. Game 1 Grenade (explodes orthogonally adjacent non-king, non-queen pieces): sacrificed on b8 to blow up rook, bishop, pawn but lost (~3:16). Game 2 Bomb (3x3 blast): draw by threefold repetition (~8:44). Game 3 Nuke (5x5 blast): dropped on c7, captured by the queen, clears a 5x5 area; he converts and mates (~13:17).
rules: Player's queen is replaced by an explosive piece that moves like a queen.

Explosion triggers when the piece captures — and also when it is captured (it detonates on the capturing square; 1:38 'let it capture, and then take all of that adjacent material', 10:05 'if I drop the nuke on C7 and get captured, that's still a captured piece').
Level 1 Grenade: destroys pieces one square in each orthogonal direction (+ shape), never kings or queens.
Level 2 Bomb: destroys all non-king pieces in the 3x3 area.
Level 3 Nuke: destroys all non-king pieces in the 5x5 area.
Exploded pieces are removed for both colours (inferred includes own pieces in radius); the explosive itself is consumed.
Kings are never affected. Normal chess otherwise.
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish; one game per level (lose with grenade, draw with bomb, win with nuke).
